Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: Senegal's National Digital ID (INN) project was launched in 2022 with UNDP support, aiming to create a biometric population database and improve integration with government systems. The New Deal Technologique makes a unique biometric digital ID a central pillar enabling secondary functional identities for health, education, justice. Integration with the new interoperability platform is planned but still under development.
redteam_note: Source is a dev/aggregator/off-topic domain — check it actually supports the score.
revision_notes: we.hse.ru replaced with a directly relevant, corroborated source: RTS and SENTV (5 July 2025) report that the civil registry authority (ANEC) and the identity/file automation authority (DAF) signed an operational interoperability protocol, with the national civil registry database (RNEC) now live — 20 million records digitised and over 10 million citizens biometrically enrolled. This is evidence of actual operational (not merely planned) bilateral data exchange underpinning digital ID, so the score is raised from Under development to Partially integrated (4).
